This dataset contains raw and processed data supporting XRD and XAFS analyses.

File description:
- .ras files: Raw XRD data acquired using synchrotron radiation.
- .dat files: Raw XAFS μ(E) data acquired using synchrotron radiation.
- .xlsx files: Processed data used for figure and table generation.

Correspondence to figures and tables:
- XRD data correspond to Fig. 1 and Table 1.
- XAFS data correspond to Figs. 2, 3 and 4, Appendix Fig. 1, and Appendix Table 1.

Data were processed using standard software packages commonly used in the field.
